allocation: LP-XXX-NNN; XXX is a three-letter namespace; NNN is never reused and ranges from 001 through 999.

conditions.description: The observed association negotiation was rejected.
conditions.name: Association rejected
conditions.remediation: Compare the rejection result, source, reason, and offered contexts with the peer configuration.

conditions.description: The observed association was aborted before normal release.
conditions.name: Association aborted
conditions.remediation: Inspect the abort source and the last observed protocol events on both legs.

conditions.description: No acceptable presentation context was observed for the association.
conditions.name: No acceptable presentation context
conditions.remediation: Offer a presentation context containing the SOP class and a transfer syntax accepted by the peer.
